## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3006. The PVC `data-ledger-db-0` is stuck in Terminating status because the `ledger-db-0` pod is still running and using it. Kubernetes' Storage Object in Use Protection feature is preventing deletion while the pod actively uses the volume. The solution is to delete the pod first—it will be automatically recreated by the StatefulSet controller, and once the pod is gone, the PVC finalizer will be removed and deletion will proceed. This is the safe approach that prevents data loss.
